positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationRecord
positions.frame: what is the official record regarding the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration?
positions.why: All three expressions cohere under one directional read: establishing what the knowledge record should hold about the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration. src-1 and src-2 are urgent imperatives to purge the record (decision-level conviction, irrealis, present), while src-3 is a flat corrective assertion that the calibration never occurred (claim-level conviction, realis, past). The tension between the irrealis purge directives and the realis corrective assertion is genuine — the directives command removal while the assertion supplies the grounding fact — but both sides serve the same question of what the official record is. The authority-ranking relational read and conservation value read span all three, holding the group together across the conviction gradient.
